item.title: The main Corona risk group is not the size people think
item.description: ﻿ Almost everyone answered this wrongly: “Globally, how many are 65 and older? A.10%, B.30%, C.50%”. We tested 20 thousand people in 32 countries with Ipsos-MORI in 2019: The results were terrible! But we were happy yesterday to see that our Facebook followers scored much better: 66% of you were correct. Please help share this […] The post The main Corona risk group is not the size people think first appeared on Gapminder.
